reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses adsorption-energy distribution shifts in CrMnFeCoNi-based systems with different elements (Mn, Ag, Cu, Nb, Mo), not Rh in PtPdRhRuIrOs, and does not link Rh to optimal binding or a 12-electron pathway. E2 mentions IrOsPtPdRhRu catalyzing a 12-electron ethanol oxidation process but does not attribute this to Rh content, d-band center modulation, or adsorption energy tuning; it also questions the applicability of d-band center theory to HEAs. Thus, the specific mechanistic claims about Rh are unsupported by the provided
